title: Recording: Let Me Roll It by Wings | 1973
content:
EMI Studios, Lagos
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

The tenth recording session for Wings’ third album, Band On The Run, took place on 14 September 1973.

The sessions were held at EMI Studios at 7 Wharf Road in Apapa, Lagos.

The precise recording dates for the Lagos sessions are not known, but it is likely that on this day they continued recording the song ‘Let Me Roll It’.

The backing track had Paul McCartney on drums, Denny Laine on electric rhythm guitar, and Linda McCartney on electric organ. The vocals and guitar riff were recorded back in England.
